text: Awful service. The numbers on the screen come up 5 to 10 minutes before they actually bother to call your orders. By the time they called mine, the screen was 20+ numbers ahead. I waited 5 minutes and then enquired about my food as they seemed to skip my number. The team member at the desk guard at me and just barked the number to the other staff. She somehow managed to be rude to the other staff whilst doing it. I git handed a bag of cold food after a few minutes. Went to the side to check my order as in the past they have managed to forget items. Only to be greeted by a dirty cloth with food remains. Which honestly is rather unhygienic. Do not go here. If that is the standard o a slow evening? There are far better places to eat in the area that are actually nice and clean.
author: Unni Catharina Forseth Mason

text: I had a experience to going to this branch today, I ordered paid and the self kiosk didn’t give me a reciept, I did go the counter the manager was not listening, then he told me to wait for the order, I waited for the order but after 10 passed I didnt recieved it, I was at the counter again the manager left and start preparing the orders, I waited there for some time the manager asked me from distance ‘what’ seeing me standing there at the counter, I did told him that I have ordered but I haven’t recieved it, he told another staff member, I waited again, then after so long time I recieved my order. would not recommend, If you want to waste your time, sure.
author: Ali Sheryar

text:
Absolutely disgusting experience 😤
- Rude staff with zero sense of customer care
- 26 minutes waiting time just for 4 Mc Flurry and a hot chocolate
- Hot Chocolate was colder than Mc  Flurry.
- Toilets were closed and customers were not allowed to use it (a guard watching over it). This was from 9:45pm'  while branch was open till 11:00 pm
- Screens were not managed' showing all the orders pending while many given away and others who were waiting were not even showing

AVOID OXFORD STREET BRANCH IF YOU CAN
author: L R

text: The worst experience I’ve ever had at a McDonald’s, at the Tottenham Court Road branch. One of the staff was using the serving trays to push down the rubbish inside the bin, pressing it with the trays themselves. Then, with the same dirty cloth that hadn’t been changed for over an hour, they “cleaned” the trays and returned them to the counter. The same cloth was also used to wipe around the rubbish bin. Honestly, this was the most disgusting and unhygienic thing I have ever seen in my life.
author: Arash Vanda

text: The food isn't fresh. They deceive children with their advertisements, offering games they don't provide, and then it's up to the parents to explain why they don't provide the games they're offering. A very bad experience. I've been there several times, really, because it's a quick way to continue shopping. The options are good, but that restaurant needs to be reviewed. It has many bad reviews for both the staff and the food.
author: Dai Galarza

text: Order regularly as i work in the area. Foods been cold, big arch sauce in a big mac is a alergen risk. My coffee freezing cold at closing time because the could not be bothered to check. If you are open late you are not just serving the clubgoers and drinkers but your fellow workers doing double shifts. Have some respect for your customers
author: Chris Pole

text: The slowest McDonald's I have ever been to. It took them 20 minutes for the simplest order and when I asked why it was taking so long, they questioned my purchase, thinking I had found the receipt. In addition, I ordered a cheeseburger with no onion and pickles. I got a burger with no cheese, but with onion!
author: Alberto 950

text: Funnily they asked me to review them BEFORE I got my meal yesterday,,, I just got back home from the hospital after the meal gave me serious food poisoning. Problem with the establishment not the staff I reckon. These things happen but I won't be back.
